name: device_battery_info
desc: 设备电量信息(电量百分比/充电状态/电池健康/温度/电压电流/循环与容量/技术类型)
cmd: echo '=== 电量 ==='; dumpsys battery 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'level|scale|status|health|temperature|voltage|current|technology|AC powered|USB powered|Wireless powered|Charge counter|Max charging current|Max charging voltage'; echo; echo '=== sysfs ==='; for f in capacity status health temp voltage_now current_now charge_full design_capacity cycle_count; do p=/sys/class/power_supply/battery/$f; if [ -f $p ]; then v=$(cat $p); if [ $f = temp ]; then v=$((v/10))'C'; fi; if [ $f = voltage_now ] || [ $f = charge_full ] || [ $f = design_capacity ]; then v=$((v/1000))'mV/mAh'; fi; echo "$f = $v"; fi; done; echo; echo '=== 温度 ==='; dumpsys thermalservice 2>/dev/null | grep -m 5 -E 'mType|mTemperature' | head -5
